audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text calls Sivir's own ult "On the Chase (R)" — Sivir's real ultimate is On the Hunt.
audit.why: The suspectNames fuzzy match ("on the hunt", distance 4) is correct; this is Sivir's own R, not Veigar's, and the fabricated name should not ship.
Sivir's Spell Shield hard-denies Veigar's Baleful Strike poke/stacking pre-6, matching the packet levelChart (Sivir L1 through 1st item, Veigar only 2+ items).
Power spikes are level 6 (Spell Shield vs Primordial Burst execute) and Rabadon's-online cage-R one-shot combo — grounded in enemyKit R (missing-health scaling) and E (stun cage).

edits.before: Once Veigar hits full AP with Rabadon's his cage-plus-R combo can delete you instantly, and Spell Shield only blocks one spell of the chain. You must space outside Event Horizon range, use your Ricochet AoE and On the Chase (R) to weave through his zone, and let a frontliner soak the cage before you commit.
edits.after: Once Veigar hits full AP with Rabadon's his cage-plus-R combo can delete you instantly, and Spell Shield only blocks one spell of the chain. You must space outside Event Horizon range, use your Ricochet AoE and On the Hunt (R) to weave through his zone, and let a frontliner soak the cage before you commit.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold near the center or leave before it forms. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Spell Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Veigar's Event Horizon (Cage) is down 20s at rank 1, 14s at max — only the edge stuns, hold center or leave before it forms. - Your Spell Shield (E) is up every 24s early, 18s at max — guard it like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Push with Ricochet so he's stuck farming under tower — every canceled Baleful Strike denies him gold and stacks.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Diving without Spell Shield up invites a cage he trades for your dive — hold the push until it's back.

notes: Fabricated Sivir R name ("On the Chase") fixed to On the Hunt in spikes[3].text (this is Sivir's own ult, not Veigar's). Both COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets rewritten to match their titles. breakdown.cooldowns now carries real Event Horizon (20s/14s) and Spell Shield (24s/18s) numbers. Veigar is male — existing he/his pronouns were already correct, no MISGENDER lint hits.
